headline: 2226 Robin Seestadt Office Building / Baumschlager Eberle Architekten
context: Brief: A group of mixed-use buildings designed on the 2226 principle, without cooling, heating, or ventilation technology, is created for Aspern Seestadt, a new and developing Vienna neighborhood that combines sustainability, quality of life, and economic dynamism.
